name: Watermark Robustness Stress Testing
description: A task to evaluate the robustness of invisible watermarks in AI-generated images against removal attacks while preserving image quality.

cr:input.name: ETI Benchmark Dataset
cr:input.description: A dataset of 600 images generated using Stable Diffusion 2.1 and Flux 1 [dev], with watermarks applied using in-processing and post-processing techniques. Watermarking methods include Gaussian Shading, StegaStamp, JigMark, PRC, StableSignature, and Trufo. Images are split into two tracks: Black-box (300 images) and Beige-box (300 images).
cr:input.encodingFormat: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset encoding format]
cr:input.contentUrl: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset download URL]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Predicted images after applying watermark removal attacks. Outputs are evaluated for watermark detection performance and image quality degradation.

field.name: image_id
field.description: Unique identifier for the image, e.g., 'image_001'.

field.name: watermark_detection_score
field.description: Post-attack watermark detection score, with lower values indicating more effective watermark removal. Example: 0.05.

field.name: image_quality_score
field.description: Image quality degradation score after attack, with lower values indicating higher quality preservation. Example: 0.10.

packages: [FILL IN THE BLANK: list of required Python packages]

cr:evaluation.primaryMetric: Euclidean distance of watermark detection and image quality scores
cr:evaluation.notes: The primary metric is computed as the Euclidean distance between image quality degradation (Q) and watermark detection performance (A). A lower score indicates better performance.
